agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The `mpc52xx_spi_probe` function failed to release allocated interrupt resources and cancel pending work items in the error handling path upon registration failure, leaving active handlers referencing memory that could be freed.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch adds `free_irq(ms->irq0, ms)`, `free_irq(ms->irq1, ms)`, and `cancel_work_sync(&ms->work)` to the `err_register` label in `drivers/spi/spi-mpc52xx.c`, ensuring these resources are cleaned up before the probe returns on failure.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes resource leaks in the probe error path by ensuring IRQs are freed and work is cancelled upon initialization failure.
intent_record.what: Inserted calls to free_irq() for irq0 and irq1, and cancel_work_sync() for ms->work into the err_register error handling block within the mpc52xx_spi_probe function.
intent_record.how: Ensures that allocated interrupt handlers and scheduled work items are properly released when the SPI host registration fails, preventing resource leaks and potential use-after-free errors during driver initialization.

grouping_result.intent: Fixes resource leaks in the probe error path by ensuring IRQs are freed and work is cancelled upon initialization failure.
